newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson shares climb on U.S., Nokia.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson shares climb on U.S., Nokia.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecommunications group AB LM Ericsson opened two percent higher on the Stockholm Stock Exchange on Thursday.
At 0920 GMT the share was 5.5 crowns higher at 251.5 crowns. The general index was 0.72 percent higher.
"It's mainly riding on the positive development of telecoms shares in the U.S. on Wednesday," said a trader with a Stockholm bank. "But the interest surrounding Nokia is also having an impact."
Finnish telecommunications group Nokia is due to release 1996 earnings later on Thursday.
But some analysts and dealers see Ericsson as overvalued at these levels.
"We are looking at putting 'reduce' on Ericsson in view of margins coming under pressure, which the market tends to see as negative in the long term," a trader said.
